note: Ficohsa only, as before: Banco Atlántida's, BAC Honduras's and Banpaís's card tariffs weren't reached in this pass. Banco Ficohsa's card rates for November 2025 (the latest the bank's regulatory page gave), read in full: it prices its personal cards by tier (each tier sold in several programmes, La Colonia, Larach, Cash Back, disfruta+, Ficohsa+, LifeMiles, AAdvantage, which share the tier's terms): Clásica Internacional, Oro Internacional, Platinum, Signature and Infinite, each at 30.00% to 46.00% a year on dollar balances (up to 51.26% on lempira ones), written at the top with the bottom as the range's lowest, in dollars, the currency their memberships are priced in; the membership, billed monthly in lempiras from the next renewal, is 5 dollars a month for the Classic, 9.17 for the Oro, 13.00 for the Platinum, 15.75 for the Signature, 25 for the Infinite and 20.83 for the Infinite LifeMiles, Black and AAdvantage cards, written as their own card. Transactions abroad in a currency other than the US dollar carry 3%. The Clásica local is a lempira-only card whose membership is priced in dollars, and isn't written; nor are the business, corporate and PyMe cards, or the debt life insurance. No minimum payment, grace period or late fee is stated.
